rows.en:
(So that's it for classes this school year.
I wonder what I should do over summer break.)

Oh, right, that reminds me.
I've got an announcement for you lot.
rows.notes: Shared male/female. Gary's rough 'omaera' rendered 'you lot' throughout the scene.

rows.en: (An announcement?)

Lemme see... From the third to the fourth week
of August, you lot are gonna help out
with a movie shoot.

Honestly, I meant to tell you way sooner,
but I went and forgot, of all things.
Yeah, sorry, sorry. My bad.
rows.notes: Shared male/female. Breezy 'suman suman' kept as a throwaway apology (the player's next line says he isn't sorry at all).

rows.en: (Gary-sensei isn't sorry one bit...)

The shoot's gonna be done together with S.M.S.
Go give it your all, you lot.

Gary-sensei, what exactly are we supposed
to do to help with the movie shoot?

Ah, right, I never told you, huh?
Relax, it's nothing that hard.

You just hop in a Valkyrie
and do a little dogfighting.

Don't worry so much.
Do it just like I've taught you, and you'll be fine.
rows.notes: Shared male/female. Answers the students' unvoiced alarm at the previous line.

rows.en:
Well, everything in life's an experience.
It'll make a nice summer break memory, too,
so go give it your all, you lot.
Okay, dismissed!

(Gary-sensei casually dropped a bombshell
and just walked off...)

(Hmm, helping with a movie shoot, huh...
It does sound like fun, though.)

(Doesn't look like I can turn it down anymore...
Okay! Since I've got the chance, I'd better enjoy it.)
(The movie shoot, and of course summer break too!)

(So that's it for classes this school year.
I wonder what I should do over summer break.)
(Gary-sensei isn't sorry one bit...)

(Gary-sensei casually dropped a bombshell
and just walked off...)

(Doesn't look like I can turn it down anymore...
Okay! Since I've got the chance, I'll enjoy it.)

Hey, \p.
Where do you think you're going?
rows.notes: Shared male/female. Literally 'what are you doing trying to go home?'.

rows.en: Huh? Was there something, Hilda-sensei?

Honestly, you...
Today's the deadline for the career plan survey.
rows.notes: Shared male/female. 'shinro kibou chousa' = career/future-plan survey.

rows.en: I'm sorry... Hilda-sensei.

I bet you lost the form, too.
Fine, then. Just tell me your answer.
rows.notes: Shared male/female. 'koutou' (orally): answer out loud instead of on paper.

rows.en: I'll fill it in for you later.
P-please do...

In three more months, you'll be a third-year too.
It's about time you gave some serious thought
to your future.

Let's see... Even if you become a soldier
to protect Frontier, there are
two militaries in Frontier.

The private military provider "S.M.S."
and Frontier's regular army,
the "New U.N. Forces."
So, what do you want to do in the future?
Enlist in "S.M.S."
Enlist in the "New U.N. Forces"
Live as a "civilian"
rows.notes: Choice. Shared male/female. Quotation marks kept as in the Japanese.

rows.en:
Okay, "Will enlist in S.M.S." it is.
I'll write it on the form and turn it in
for you, so don't worry.
rows.notes: Shared male/female. Hilda quotes what she will write on the form.

rows.en: And don't you forget to turn it in next time.
Yes, ma'am. I'm sorry.
rows.notes: Shared male/female. 'hai' to a strict teacher rendered 'Yes, ma'am' (Hilda is female per glossary).

rows.en:
Okay, "Will enlist in the New U.N. Forces" it is.
I'll write it on the form and turn it in
for you, so don't worry.

And don't forget to turn it in next time,
got it?
rows.notes: x4, male and female, after two of the three choices.

rows.en: Yes... I'm sorry...

Okay, "Will live as a civilian" it is.
I'll write it on the form and turn it in
for you, so don't worry.

Ah!? Oh, that's right, it is!
I'm sorry...

In three more months, you'll all be third-years.
It's about time you gave some serious thought
to your future.
What do you want to do in the future?

(My future plans, huh...
I wonder what's waiting for me in my future?)

(Starting today, I'm a third-year in high school.
It feels kinda strange to think I've only got
one year of school life left...)
(So much happened over these two years.)
(Meeting Alto, Yuuto, and the others...)

(Getting to know the "Galactic Fairy" Sheryl
and the "Super Dimension Cinderella" Ranka...)

(Sports Day, the Culture Fest...
Oh, and just recently I helped out
with a movie shoot, too.)
rows.notes: taiikusai = 'sports festival' (not in the glossary; lowercase common noun). Aligned to the glossary decision of 2026-10-17.

rows.en: (It was all so much fun...)

What're you getting all lost in thought for,
\p?

Oh, Alto. When I thought about only having
one year of school left, the last two years
started to feel kind of nostalgic.

Geez, this is no time to wallow in memories.
We just took our first step toward
the "future."
Yeah, you're right...

Come on, let's get going.
Michel and the others are waiting.

Look who's talking. You're the one who's
itching to fly the most, Alto.
S-so what if I am!?

Haha, of course you're excited.
I mean, after all...

We've finally arrived at the new planet
we've been searching for all this time.

(Starting today, I'm a third-year in high school.
It feels kind of strange to think I've only got
one year of school life left...)
(So much happened over these two years.)
(Meeting Saotome-kun, Kagura-kun, and the others...)

(Getting to know the "Galactic Fairy" Sheryl-san
and the "Super Dimension Cinderella"
Ranka-chan...)

(Sports Day, the Culture Fest...
Oh, and just recently I helped out
with a movie shoot, too.)
rows.notes: Aligned to the glossary decision of 2026-10-17.

rows.en:
Oh, Saotome-kun. When I thought about only
having one year of school left, the last
two years started to feel kind of nostalgic.
Yes, you're right...

Look who's talking. You're the one who's
itching to fly the most, Saotome-kun.

Hehe, of course you're excited.
I mean, after all...

We've finally arrived at the new planet
we've been searching for all this time.
